original_description: Suggest books a reader might like.
suggested_description: Suggest books a reader might like from a title they enjoyed. Use when the reader names a book and asks what to read next.
diagnosis: The description never says it takes a title the reader liked, so 'what next' routes to the book details.
rationale: Naming the input and the question shape moves the boundary.
risks: Detail questions that name a title may now flip.
